name: Early Bird Discounts for WooCommerce
author: debutstudio

sections.description:
Easily set start and end dates for your WooCommerce sale pricing.
Display an automatic countdown badge showing when the offer ends — perfect for time-limited or early bird promotions.

Features

  • Set start and end dates for Early Bird pricing automatically.
  • Display “Hurry, ends soon” countdown badges on products.
  • Boost conversions with urgency-driven limited-time offers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Products → Edit Product → Early Bird section to enable and configure your offer.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. The free version applies Early Bird pricing at the product level. Pro version will include per-variation options.
